messages:
alex: pagerbot fired for pd:prod-inference-high-5xx at 03:12 UTC :rotating_light:
pagerbot: PagerDuty incident PD-8932 created and triggered (incidents@redwood) — paging rotation: oncall-inference.ack required.
incident-bot: Automatic runbook attached: /runbooks/inference/5xx-spike. Links: https://redwood.runbooks/5xx-spike
maria: acked PD-8932, i'm on it. quick summary? what customers impacted?
jonah: i saw a small spike in 5xx from model-router service, region eu-west1. metrics: 5xx rate went from 0.01% to ~1.8% in ~2m.
sara: paging from alerts: error budget burn, autoscaler healthy. logs show repeated upstream connection resets from frontend-proxy -> model-router.
carla: adding context: yesterday we changed socket timeout in model-router from 10s -> 4s for a perf patch. rolling update finished 02:45 UTC.
maria: ok can someone grep logs for that deploy id? pattern is model-router:v2.14.7.
jonah: running quick query: ``curl -s 'https://kibana/api/logs/_search' -d '{"query":"model-router v2.14.7 socket closed"}'`` shows many "connection reset by peer" entries starting at 03:10. snippet:
```
[03:11:03] model-router v2.14.7 - connection reset by peer during send (upstream 10.2.7.5:8080)
[03:11:04] model-router v2.14.7 - failed to stream tokens to runtime-kernel-03
```
maria: sounds like the 4s timeout caused premature closes under tail latencies. rolling back to v2.14.6 might be fastest mitigation. who can trigger?
alex: i'm rotating to take lead; tagging @carla for rollback since she owned the deploy. alex -> oncall handoff noted.
carla: i can roll back. will run a canary rollback to 20% first. command: ``kubectl set image deployment/model-router model-router=image:redwood/model-router:v2.14.6 --record`` then watch pods.
incident-bot: Change control detected — deploying image redwood/model-router:v2.14.6 to deployment/model-router (canary 20%).
jonah: i'll watch metrics and traces. setting a dashboard alert to DM this thread if 5xx > 0.5% for 5m.
sara: support-oncall-bot, pls prepare customer-impact note for Status page draft: short blurb, region affected, ETA for fix if rollback successful.
support-oncall-bot: Draft prepared: "We are investigating elevated errors impacting inference requests in EU-West1 since ~03:10 UTC. Engineers are rolling back a recent model-router change; we expect partial recovery within 10–15 minutes. We'll update shortly."
maria: ack — good. sending to status page now. (posted)
alex: rollback initiated at 03:18 UTC. pods terminating and new pods coming up. watching canary.
jonah: canary new pod logs look healthy, downstream connections stable. 5xx on canary ~0.02%.
carla: promoting to full rollback now: kubectl rollout undo deployment/model-router --to-revision=148
incident-bot: Rollout event: model-router rollback to revision 148 started by carla.
maria: 03:22 UTC 5xx rate across eu-west1 already dropping to 0.15%
sara: keeping customers notified — updated status: "Partial recovery observed; majority of traffic restored. Continuing monitoring."
alex: will keep PD incident open until stable for 30m. quick postmortem owners? carla + jonah for infra/root cause, maria for comms, alex for mitigation timeline.
carla: noted. grabbing logs for a postmortem bundle now (`/scripts/pm_bundle.sh PD-8932`).
jonah: added initial hypothesis to incident doc: "aggressive socket timeout introduced in v2.14.7 caused mid-tail request closes leading to 5xx under typical network jitter".
pagerbot: PD-8932 status changed: acknowledged by maria, status: in_progress; responders: maria, carla, jonah, alex.
maria: thanks everyone. ping me if any regression or if latency spikes while rollback finishes.
alex: last check at 03:25 UTC: 5xx ~0.04%, latency normal. marking note: begin 30m stabilization window. will post final update after stabilization. :white_check_mark:
support-oncall-bot: Customer-impact update posted to status.redwood.ai: "Partial outage in EU-West1 affecting inference requests; majority restored after rollback. Ongoing monitoring."
